# Design templates

Copy templates into the active milestone/research directory. Replace instructional
content and link PRD, EDD, Test Design, ADRs, and evidence. A copied template is
not an approved design. Write only the detail needed for the active milestone.

- [ADR](ADR_TEMPLATE.md)
